raw:
# Lesson 86

##### enough和fairly的区别

enough表示足够的(具有某种目的的含义)

fairly表示相当的

##### 短语动词

use up  用尽

swing round  突然转身

to sit on a swing   荡秋千

sth be in full swing   ...正在火热进行中

desperate to do sth ...   十分想做某事

in desperation    绝望中

drift off/drift into sleep   缓缓入睡

be dismayed at sth   对...感到沮丧

with/in dismay  沮丧的
